method: Actual shipped cores in Node VM, mathematical intercept and real projectile/convoy integration; no browser or production storage

groups.name: Tab selection, HUD lock, lasers and missiles agree
Solid Citadel and asteroid block lock without consuming a missile
Blocked selected objective keeps navigation while weapon picks a clear ship
Warp, invulnerability and destroyed targets never capture weapons
One visible lock cone also controls laser correction
Orbit and convoy solve actual flight time from each weapon muzzle
Moving orbit target is hit by the actual projectile integrator
Actual convoy AI receives weapon hits and refreshes lock without firing
Behind, distant and unreachable ships cannot produce an impossible lock
Missile lifetime, cooldown, ammunition and upgrades remain intact
Parallax supports stay targetable before the central core
Pause neither shoots nor spends ammunition
MRG remains manual for facing, pointer aim and grenades
Repeated addon loading is idempotent
